resources.string: Shows your WA Reach admin the calls you make to leads: when, and for how long.
Use the same email and password you use for WA Reach. Ask your admin if you don\'t have them.
❌ Call history: not allowed. Calls can\'t be sent.
⚠️ The phone may stop this app in the background
Sign this phone out? Your calls stop going to WA Reach, and your admin will see the phone is no longer connected.
A new version (%1$s) is available. Tap to download.
Only calls with your business\'s leads are kept. WA Reach ignores every other call on this phone. Recordings are sent only for calls with leads, and only if this phone\'s dialer records calls.
Recordings come from the phone\'s own dialer. Turn on call recording in the Phone app\'s settings if your phone has it.
Allow call history access in WA Reach Calls.
Couldn\'t reach WA Reach. It will try again when the phone is online.
